digest.component_or_area: CLI parser and route registry foundation (S2a)
propositions: A stdlib-only CLI parser factory protocol and route registry must be defined without importing handlers or optional dependencies to enable safe migration of existing command sets.

Route records must hold lazy handler/parser-factory references with identity, alias, visibility, help, mount, confirmation, output, and capability metadata while validating duplicates, alias/retired collisions, contradictory policies, and unknown capabilities deterministically without resolving handlers.

The custom ArgumentParser formatter must produce deterministic fixed-width help output with UTF-8 LF line endings, one trailing newline, and compatibility-shaped parse errors independent of terminal width.
Registry construction and route lookup must provably import neither handlers nor optional packages, enforced via import isolation tests in subprocess isolation.
Frozen route records must represent every current spelling and derive legacy policy-set exports with zero delta against existing command sets without cutting help or execution paths.
